parameters.name: CertNo
parameters.description: The ID card number to add to the whitelist.

parameters.name: CertifyId
parameters.description: The certificate ID. The user associated with this authentication is added to the whitelist.

parameters.name: ServiceCode
parameters.description:
The service type. Valid values:
- **antcloudauth**: Financial-grade ID Verification.
- **cloudauthst** (discontinued): ID Verification Enhanced Edition.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value.

parameters.name: ValidDay
parameters.description: The number of valid days after the whitelist is created.
